instruction: Modify an LDAP entry (replace attribute)
output:
ldapmodify -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com -W <<< 'dn: uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com
changetype: modify
replace: mail
mail: jdoe@newdomain.com'

instruction: Modify LDAP entry to add an attribute
output:
ldapmodify -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com -W <<< 'dn: uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com
changetype: modify
add: telephoneNumber
telephoneNumber: +1-555-1234'

instruction: Modify LDAP entry to delete an attribute
output:
ldapmodify -x -D cn=admin,dc=example,dc=com -W <<< 'dn: uid=jdoe,dc=example,dc=com
changetype: modify
delete: telephoneNumber'
